csv_project_name: AE for Various campus Structural Engineering Services
csv_scope_of_work: The University of California, Riverside (UCR) invites qualified consultants with relevant experience to submit written statements of qualifications to provide structural engineering consulting services for various campus projects under review of the Campus Building Official, ranging from structural review, analysis and verification of existing buildings for structural compliance for equipment relocation and installations, small to complex alterations, remodels, renovations and new construction.

title: AE for Various Campus Structural Engineering Services
short_description: On-call structural engineering services for diverse university campus building projects and reviews.
project_location: University of California Riverside, Riverside, California, USA
project_scope: On-call structural engineering consulting for various campus projects under review by the Campus Building Official, including structural review, analysis and verification of existing buildings for structural compliance related to equipment relocation and installations, as well as small to complex alterations, remodels, renovations, and new construction. No specific building sizes, spans, or gross floor areas are stated.
services: Structural engineering consulting services on an on-call basis; structural review; analysis; verification of existing buildings for code/structural compliance; support for equipment relocation and installations; services for alterations, remodels, renovations, and new construction. Related disciplines listed include architecture, civil engineering, cost estimating, feasibility studies, inspection services, and planning/master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- University campus projects are generally of strategic interest to sbp.
- Scope includes structural engineering for existing and new buildings, which aligns partly with sbp's expertise.
- Potentially includes complex alterations and new construction, but no specific landmark, long-span, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- This is an on-call/multi-project services contract rather than a defined signature project.
- Includes broad consulting and review tasks, not clearly focused on innovative lightweight or special structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. The procurement is for on-call consulting services covering multiple campus projects of varying size, including compliance reviews, renovations, alterations, and new construction. Because no project list, building areas, or budgets are provided, a realistic aggregate construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee or contract value is stated in the notice. One or two firms will be awarded a renewable on-call contract with a 24-month base period and 24-month renewal option, but without upset limits, task-order volumes, or hourly rate schedules, a realistic fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultants with relevant experience in structural engineering consulting for campus projects are requested. Specific minimum reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the notice.
contracting_authority: University of California, Riverside (UCR), Riverside, CA, USA. Contact: Mary Ramirez. Phone: 951-827-2528. Email: mary.ramirez@ucr.edu. Website: https://www.ucrplanroom.com/projects/155/details/rfq-on-call-structural-engineering-consulting-services
notes: RFP/RFQ for one or two firms. Contract duration: 24-month base period with 24-month renewal option. Questions deadline: 06/11/2026 12:00 PM PDT. Small Business Enterprise participation goal noted. Prevailing wage rates may apply. Tender is time-sensitive and submission is online.
